property_summary: After a play() call with exactly the ticket amount, the pot is either unchanged (when no payout occurs) or zero (when a payout occurs), so the post-call pot equals the pre-call pot plus 10 only if no payout occurred, and equals 0 only if a payout occurred.

confirmed_difference.thread_focus: the value of state variable `pot` after a call to `play(...)` completes
